Volunteer.description: A volunteer at the food bank, known by the name they go by. A first name alone is not an identity.

Partner.description: An organisation that donates food or refers households.

Liaison.description:
Which volunteer handles a partner: its point of contact, the driver who collects from it, or the signatory for its deliveries.
Driving for a partner is not being its contact.

Buddy.description: A link between two volunteers on shift: one is trained by the other, or is relieved by the other at handover.

Delivery.description: Donated goods arriving from a partner. driven_by brought them, received_by signed them in, checked_by inspected them. An expected delivery has not arrived.

Parcel.description: A food parcel for a referred household; collected means the household picked it up.

questions.q: Who is the driver for Harbourside Market?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Partner)-[:driver]->(n1:Volunteer) WHERE n0.org = 'Harbourside Market' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.speaker: duc
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)-[:pickups]->(n1:Partner) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.org AS org

questions.speaker: hodan
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)-[:trainer]->(n1:Volunteer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: Who is a trainee of Iker Zubiri?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)-[:trainee]->(n1:Volunteer) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Iker Zubiri' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as
MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.goods = 'yoghurt' RETURN n0.chilled AS chilled

questions.q: Is there a record that the rice was chilled?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery) WHERE n0.goods = 'rice' RETURN coalesce(n0.chilled, false) AS chilled

questions.q: Which deliveries did Efua Mensah drive?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)<-[:driven_by]-(n1:Delivery) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Efua Mensah' RETURN n1.goods AS goods
MATCH (n0:Delivery)-[:checked_by]->(n1:Volunteer) WHERE n0.goods = 'yoghurt' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: How many crates came from Northgate Mosque?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Partner)<-[:donor]-(n1:Delivery) WHERE n0.org = 'Northgate Mosque' RETURN n1.crates AS crates

questions.q: Which households did I pack for?
questions.speaker: hodan
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)<-[:packed_by]-(n1:Parcel) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.household AS household

questions.q: How many people are in the Abdi household?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parcel) WHERE n0.household = 'Abdi household' RETURN n0.people AS people

questions.q: Does the Kovac household need halal food?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parcel) WHERE n0.household = 'Kovac household' RETURN n0.halal AS halal

questions.q: Which parcels did St Agnes Pantry refer?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Partner)<-[:referred_by]-(n1:Parcel) WHERE n0.org = 'St Agnes Pantry' RETURN n1.household AS household
MATCH (n0:Partner)-[:signatory]->(n1:Volunteer) WHERE n0.org = 'Northgate Mosque' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: What are the goods and condition of every delivery?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delivery) RETURN n0.goods AS goods, n0.condition AS condition

questions.speaker: efua
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Volunteer)-[:contacts]->(n1:Partner) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.org AS org
MATCH (n0:Parcel) WHERE n0.dietary_note CONTAINS 'nuts' RETURN n0.household AS household
